result_preview.description: Provides programmatic access to campaign contact engagement data, enabling retrieval and management of customer interaction states throughout omnichannel journey orchestration. Exposes contact engagement records linked to campaigns and customer accounts to support real-time personalization and journey state tracking across marketing touchpoints.

result_preview.title: Journey Contact State API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for querying and updating real-time contact engagement state within active customer journeys.
result_preview.description: Exposes real-time contact state data for customers currently enrolled in active journeys, including engagement metrics, journey step progress, and interaction history. Enables external systems to query contact journey status, update custom attributes mid-journey, and trigger journey state changes based on external events. Essential for omnichannel orchestration and real-time personalization decisions.

result_preview.title: Customer Interaction Journey API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and synchronizes customer touchpoint data across marketing campaigns and multi-channel communications.
result_preview.description: Exposes customer interaction records and engagement metadata from campaigns to support dynamic orchestration of personalized marketing experiences. Enables access to contact journey progression, historical engagement patterns, and account attributes for real-time routing decisions across marketing channels. Facilitates unified view of customer communications to drive consistent omnichannel messaging and campaign performance optimization.
